notes: First run: sign in at the site's address with the admin email you entered and the generated password on the first-run card. Langfuse's headless initialization (LANGFUSE_INIT_*) creates that user as owner of the organization "Default organization" with the project "Default project" on the first start; it does nothing once they exist. Sign-up is off (AUTH_DISABLE_SIGNUP), so further users join by invitation from the organization settings. Change the password under the account settings after the first sign-in.

Services from the official docker-compose.yml of the v4.57.0 release: langfuse-web (the published app, port 3000), langfuse-worker, ClickHouse, Redis, PostgreSQL and S3 storage. The web image's own entrypoint runs the PostgreSQL and ClickHouse migrations on every start before the server starts. Every image is pinned exactly; upstream floats langfuse:4, clickhouse-server:25.12, redis:7 and postgres:17.

S3 storage is pgsty/silo, a MinIO-compatible image with pinned releases (the official compose uses cgr.dev/chainguard/minio, which only publishes latest). It is reachable only inside the app's network; its start command creates the langfuse bucket, as upstream's does. Ingested events and media are stored there under events/ and media/. Because the storage is not published, multimodal media that SDKs upload directly to S3 through presigned URLs cannot be uploaded; traces, observations, scores, prompts and evaluations work normally.

ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 64 hex characters. The panel's secrets are alphanumeric, so web and worker derive it at start from the 32-character ENCRYPTION_KEY_SEED with sha256sum (the same seed always gives the same key), then drop the seed from the environment. It encrypts stored LLM API keys; the seed must never change after install.

HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 makes the Next.js server listen on every interface (it otherwise binds to the container's hostname), so the healthcheck can reach it on 127.0.0.1. NEXTAUTH_URL is the url key and sets the address used for sign-in callbacks and links.

Secrets: NEXTAUTH_SECRET, SALT, ENCRYPTION_KEY_SEED, ADMIN_PASSWORD, DB_PASSWORD, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD and MINIO_PASSWORD, each 32 alphanumeric characters. SALT hashes API keys; changing it invalidates every key.

Memory: langfuse-web takes the app limit (floor 1g); langfuse-worker 1g, ClickHouse 2g (it does not fit the 512m database default), storage 512m; PostgreSQL and Redis use the panel database default. Redis runs with maxmemory-policy noeviction, as upstream requires for its queues.
